theorems.name: Submission.lpf_tde_uniform_lipschitz_near_compact
theorems.statement: ∀ (P Q : ℕ) (U K : Set (Eucl P)) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q), IsOpen U → LocallyLipschitzOn U f → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ (C : ℝ≥0) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ball x ρ ⊆ U ∧ LipschitzOnWith C f (ball x ρ)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
